title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan

thread.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan • FX Senshi Kurumi-chan - Episode 1 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters found the premiere unexpectedly compelling, tense, and memorable.
Several appreciated its unusual financial-trading premise and found the anxiety effective even without trading experience.
Some were interested in continuing, especially to see how Kurumi develops.
Commenters liked the dark, psychologically intense direction but were surprised because the cute presentation suggested a lighter comedy.
A minority found the episode too depressing or unsettling and said they would not continue.
Some questioned the characters’ risky financial decisions and wanted deeper scrutiny of the trading practices.

notes: The title and page label explicitly identify FX Senshi Kurumi-chan, episode 1. Reddit’s rendered page exposed the discussion and comments but not reliable numeric score or total-comment metadata, so those fields are recorded as 0. Comments were paraphrased and plot details were omitted.
